*Daily values (DVs) are reference numbers based on the recommended dietary  
allowance. They were developed to help consumers determine if a food contains a lot 
or a little of a specific nutrient. The DV for fiber is 25 g. The percent DV (%DV) listed 
on the Nutrition Facts panel of food labels states the percentage of the DV provided in 
1 serving. %DVs are based on a 2000-calorie diet.
